title: Permutation linearizations and normalization of orbit tensor powers
statement: Let $H$ be a finite group, $X,Y$ schemes [def-pc-scheme], and $a:H\to\operatorname{Aut}(X)$ satisfy $a_1=1$ and $a_{gh}=a_h;a_g$. Let $q:X\to Y$ satisfy $a_h;q=q$ and let $L$ be any module sheaf. For $N=\bigotimes_h a_h^*L$ [def-sfb-pencil-orbit-bundle-norm], there exist isomorphisms $\lambda_g:a_g^*N\simeq N$ and $\lambda_{d,g}:a_g^*(N^{\otimes d})\simeq N^{\otimes d}$ for all $d\geq0$. Both obey the unit and cocycle laws relative to the normalized identity and composition comparisons [def-per-orbit-tensor-section-comparisons]: $\lambda_{gh}=\lambda_h\circ a_h^*\lambda_g\circ c_{g,h}$. For every open $T\subseteq Y$ and every $s\in\Gamma(q^{-1}T,L)$, $\lambda_g$ fixes the pullback of the orbit frame $\bigotimes_h a_h^*s$, and $\lambda_{d,g}$ fixes its pure $d$th power, including $d=0$. No finite-morphism, invariant-ring or invertibility hypothesis is imposed.

proof.text: Apply [lem-weil-pbc-module-pullback-tensor] to distribute pullback over the iterated tensor, including the unit. The normalized composition comparison identifies the pulled-back factor indexed by h with the one indexed by hg. Right multiplication by g permutes the finite enumeration of H. Use the symmetry and associativity of [lem-weil-pbc-module-tensor-symmetric-monoidal] to reorder those factors and obtain lambda_g.

For the identity, the factor permutation is the identity. For two elements the composite permutations h -> hg -> hgk give the permutation for gk. The symmetric monoidal coherence identities and the uniqueness of the unit-compatible pullback comparisons identify the resulting maps. This proves the normalized unit and cocycle laws.

Iterate the tensor pullback comparison to define the tensor-power maps. At degree zero take its unit map. The tensor-section and symmetry formulas show that each orbit section, and each of its powers, is fixed. The same permutation and composition calculation proves the power unit and cocycle laws.

theorem exists_orbit_tensor_linearizations {H : Type v} [Group H] [Finite H]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (a : H → (X ≅ X))
    (a_one : (a 1).hom = 𝟙 X)
    (a_mul : ∀ g h : H, (a (g * h)).hom = (a h).hom ≫ (a g).hom)
    (q : X ⟶ Y) (aq : ∀ h : H, (a h).hom ≫ q = q) (L : X.Modules) :
    ∃ (lin : ∀ g : H,
        (tensorPullback (a g).hom).obj (pencilOrbitBundle a L) ≅ pencilOrbitBundle a L)
      (linPow : ∀ (d : ℕ) (g : H),
        (tensorPullback (a g).hom).obj ((pencilOrbitBundle a L).tensorPow d) ≅
          (pencilOrbitBundle a L).tensorPow d),
      (lin 1).hom = (orbitLinearizationUnit a a_one (pencilOrbitBundle a L)).hom ∧
      (∀ g h : H, (lin (g * h)).hom =
        (orbitLinearizationComp a a_mul (pencilOrbitBundle a L) g h).hom ≫
          (tensorPullback (a h).hom).map (lin g).hom ≫ (lin h).hom) ∧
      (∀ d : ℕ, (linPow d 1).hom =
        (orbitLinearizationUnit a a_one ((pencilOrbitBundle a L).tensorPow d)).hom) ∧
      (∀ (d : ℕ) (g h : H), (linPow d (g * h)).hom =
        (orbitLinearizationComp a a_mul ((pencilOrbitBundle a L).tensorPow d) g h).hom ≫
          (tensorPullback (a h).hom).map (linPow d g).hom ≫ (linPow d h).hom) ∧
      (∀ (T : Y.Opens) (s : Γ(L, q ⁻¹ᵁ T)) (g : H),
        (lin g).hom.app (q ⁻¹ᵁ T)
          (orbitInvariantPullback (a g).hom (pencilOrbitBundle a L) (q ⁻¹ᵁ T)
            (congrArg (fun k : X ⟶ Y ↦ k ⁻¹ᵁ T) (aq g))
            (orbitTensorFrame a L (q ⁻¹ᵁ T)
              (fun h ↦ congrArg (fun k : X ⟶ Y ↦ k ⁻¹ᵁ T) (aq h)) s)) =
          orbitTensorFrame a L (q ⁻¹ᵁ T)
            (fun h ↦ congrArg (fun k : X ⟶ Y ↦ k ⁻¹ᵁ T) (aq h)) s) ∧
      (∀ (d : ℕ) (T : Y.Opens) (s : Γ(L, q ⁻¹ᵁ T)) (g : H),
        (linPow d g).hom.app (q ⁻¹ᵁ T)
          (orbitInvariantPullback (a g).hom ((pencilOrbitBundle a L).tensorPow d)
            (q ⁻¹ᵁ T) (congrArg (fun k : X ⟶ Y ↦ k ⁻¹ᵁ T) (aq g))
            (orbitPowerSection (pencilOrbitBundle a L) (q ⁻¹ᵁ T) d
              (fun _ ↦ orbitTensorFrame a L (q ⁻¹ᵁ T)
                (fun h ↦ congrArg (fun k : X ⟶ Y ↦ k ⁻¹ᵁ T) (aq h)) s))) =
          orbitPowerSection (pencilOrbitBundle a L) (q ⁻¹ᵁ T) d
            (fun _ ↦ orbitTensorFrame a L (q ⁻¹ᵁ T)
              (fun h ↦ congrArg (fun k : X ⟶ Y ↦ k ⁻¹ᵁ T) (aq h)) s))
